title: IMS Atlas: an open tool to build and backtest international market selection indices
description: Browser-based open-source tool to build, compare, stress-test and backtest international market selection (IMS) indices on open data. Companion software to the ims-backtest reference engine.

creators.name: Baena-Rojas, Jose Jaime
creators.affiliation: Pontificia Universidad Católica del Perú; Universidad Internacional de La Rioja
